# Cloak of the Manta Ray (`magic-items:cloak-of-the-manta-ray`)
**Category:** [Wondrous Items](../equipment-categories/wondrous-items.md) | **Rarity:** Uncommon | **Attunement:** Yes

Wondrous Item

While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.
